N2_additive_update.scope: Updated primary macro-density anchor. Original38-rounded arithmetic remains correct for its stated source and is preserved; no duplicate internal-periphery area charge, no PVT/timing/energy inference.

decision.current_blocker: No legally accessible complete numeric timing/MR/refresh/address contract for the measured part and no proven calibration-to-organization join. Exact service/energy coupling cannot be built without assumptions that would decide the result.
decision.goal: Discriminate distributed precomputed dataset service vs full-local or tiered private scratchpad using retained causal windows.
decision.next_test_if_gate_closes: One retained-window finite-credit causal bank-service/energy comparison with matching command legality and byte/owner checks. Keep local SRAM and whole-machine energy unknown until characterized. No test is authorized or presented as ready now.
decision.smallest_required_input: One authoritative exact device/controller configuration covering part/rank/row/burst mapping, programmed RL/WL, shared-bus timing, ACT/PRE/tRRD/tFAW/tRTP/turnarounds, refresh vs temperature and receiver delay, tied to compatible measured current data.

energy_scope.admitted: Pinned HBM2 per-PC current configuration is measurement-derived; sum used and idle PCs and retain pattern/temperature/structural sensitivity. Author device config removes821.3mA board offset.
energy_scope.background_limit: 16*11.756mA*1.2V; precharged background only, not full idle/refresh/system power.
energy_scope.not_admitted: Current anchors are not guaranteed worst-case currents for an identified part/PVT. No transfer to HBM3E/HBM4, and no inference of local SRAM, host PHY/controller, regulator, cooling or whole-machine2.5mJ/hash.

geometry_reconciliation.mapping_warning: Consecutive32B pieces need not hit the same bank under the documented AMD default. Artificial bank locality cannot be assumed.
geometry_reconciliation.measurement_mapping_gap: Paper8K rows/SID0 versus author16K-row4GiB single-rank abstraction remains unresolved. Do not relabel/rewrite either or silently add a rank.
geometry_reconciliation.namespace_requirement: Dataset(epoch,line) and mutable SP(context,epoch,address) need injective disjoint placement, plus explicit rank/SID/bank/row/column translation. Logical64B parent ownership covers both32B bursts and joined return; partial RMW bytes and order must remain exact.

primary_references.admitted: 4H4GB:14row bits,5column-burst bits,16banks perPC.8H8GB addsSID as bank/rank selector. Default bank-group interleave placesBG0 at byte-address bit5; a64B AXI access can become two32B commands to different bank groups.
primary_references.limit: A legitimate AXI-controller mapping, not proof DRAM Bender or the measured chips use that exact map. No part-specific numeric timing table here.

single_reference_contract_draft.name: HBM2_AUTHOR_1200MT_REFERENCE_ONLY
single_reference_contract_draft.policy_when_bound: Finite parent queue and return credits, explicit shared command bus, per-bank row state, no future reads, ordered overlap/store/RMW ownership; insert refresh before deadlines and account idle as well as active PCs. Conservative closed-page serialization is only valid after numeric constraints are bound.
single_reference_contract_draft.why_no_arbitrary_padding: Choosing22 instead of7, generic DDR4 limits, or a long guessed wait does not prove exact HBM2 legality or bound refresh deadlines. It would be a sensitivity, not the requested evidence-qualified model.

source_reconciliation.RL_role: MemSpecHBM2.h labels tRL CAS latency; MemSpecHBM2.cpp timeToCompletion(RD) returns tRL+tBurst. Thus7 is consumed for completion accounting, not merely auto-precharge.
source_reconciliation.legality: HBM2::handleRead/handleWrite increment counters; this power engine is not the required bank/channel/CA/data-bus scheduler or a complete legality validator.
source_reconciliation.parser: HBM2_runner.cpp:34-59 loads organization and nRL=7; nCL=22 is not read. No nRRD/nFAW/nRTP/nRTW/nREFI fields are bound in MemTimingSpec.
source_reconciliation.refresh: HBM2::handleRefAll handles explicit REFA and blocks/accounting interval tRFC=210 when commanded. It does not generate periodic refresh from nREFI=2340. Those config references alone do not create a legal command trace.
